sections.name: Mains
items: Section note: Served with choice of fries or house green salad unless noted. Sub tots or kale Caesar 3.

The Reignstorm Burger 19. Grass-fed beef, stoneground mustard aioli, dill pickle, Tillamook sharp cheddar, heirloom tomato, iceberg, sweet onion, brioche. Sub Jack and Annie's jackfruit patty 3. Add bacon 5, extra patty 7, avocado 4.

The Celly Burger 21. Juicy chili-infused grass-fed beef patty or R+T's charred black bean and sweet corn patty, grilled poblano, pepper jack, iceberg, sweet onion, heirloom tomato, chipotle aioli, brioche. Extra patty or honey-cured bacon 5. Guacamole 4. Cannot be made vegan or fully gluten-free.
Jordyn's Poutine 19. Fries, Wisconsin white cheddar curds, cremini and shiitake mushroom gravy, miso garlic king oyster mushroom. Vegetarian, gluten-free.

Phoebe's Mushroom Miso Grilled Cheese 20. Sharp Tillamook white cheddar, smoked gouda, miso garlic butter, caramelized onions and mushrooms, hot honey, Macrina organic white sourdough, parmesan crust. Pro tip: add bacon 5 or avocado 4.
The May + Walsh Mac + Cheese 21. Skillet-baked shells, aged white cheddar, smoked gouda, garlic bread crumbs. Sub gluten-free pasta and no bread crumbs 3. Add bacon or grilled chicken 6. No sides.

The Runner's Rice Bowl 21. Brown rice, slaw, spiced cucumber, mango, edamame, scallions, pickled ginger, wasabi peas, creamy wasabi-ginger dressing, furikake, nori. Choice of gochujang glazed salmon 8, pork belly 8, or soy-marinated tofu 6. Gluten-free available. No sides.

The Bird 20. Fried chicken, slaw, house-made bread and butter pickles, chipotle aioli, brioche. Sub Jack and Annie's jackfruit tenders 3.

Ji so-YUM's Braised Pork Belly or Tofu Sliders 23. Three soy and ginger braised tofu or pork belly sliders with gochujang glaze, grilled pineapple, scallion slaw, Hawaiian bun. Not served with other sides. Cannot be made gluten-free or vegan.

The Title IX Banh Mi 21. Garlic-marinated tofu or lemongrass chicken, cucumber, pickled carrot and radish, jalapeno, cilantro, garlic aioli, Thanh Son bakery baguette. Vegan mayo and baguette available.
The OG B.L.A.T. 20. Bacon, lettuce, avocado, heirloom tomato, garlic aioli, Macrina organic white sourdough.
The Goat 20. R+T honey-marinated grilled chicken breast, honey and herbed goat cheese, Mama Lil's peppers, arugula, Macrina organic white sourdough.
The CC Green Chili Tuna Melt 20. Dolphin-safe white albacore, grilled poblano and serrano green chili peppers, red onion, cilantro, Tillamook pepper jack cheese, Macrina organic white sourdough.
Fishlock + Chips 24. Beer-battered wild-caught Pacific cod, slaw, tartar. Sub salad or tots 3.

Cierra's Street Tacos 23. Two chicken tinga, pork carnitas, or Impossible tacos, corn tortilla, lettuce, pineapple pico, pickled red onion, salsa verde, lime crema, house tortilla chips. Sub fries, salad, or gluten-free tortilla chips 3. Make it three 7. Add guacamole 4.
